title: Create: Jetpack-Vessel-Recipefix
description: Fixes the duplicate recipe conflict between the Small Filling Tank (Create Stuff 'N Additions) and the Fluid Vessel (Create: Connected).
body:
- Fixes the duplicate recipe conflict between the Small Filling Tank (Create Stuff 'N Additions) and the Fluid Vessel (Create: Connected).
- ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d5538eab784ebaaf6d22058b53d7785148f7edc.png)
- You can now finally craft Fluid Tanks into Fluid Vessels without ending up with a Small Filling Tank; while the recipe has been made more expensive by 4 copper ingots, copper can be found everywhere.
